checks.evidence: SG32 lines 22-23 and SG36-ZF line 21 place Liu Bei's retreat, Cao Cao's pursuit, and Zhang Fei's twenty mounted rear guard at Dangyang Changban. SG36-ZF says 據水斷橋 and then 敵皆無敢近者，故遂得免. YY42 line 43 supplies the novel's later command to dismantle the bridge. The opening asks rather than asserts that a shout broke it.

checks.item: new SG36 bridge quote and callback scene 50
checks.evidence: SG36-ZF line 21 reads 身是張益德也，可來共決死！敵皆無敢近者，故遂得免. Scenes 49-50 quote these clauses exactly and identify Liu Bei's escape without claiming all companions or baggage escaped.
YY42 line 36 narrates 曹操身邊夏侯傑 ... 倒撞於馬下. Scene 62 says only 小說給他一個名字：夏侯傑. It assigns no unsupported rank and scene 61 describes a fall, not a historical death.

Narration explicitly introduces the novel at scene 37 and re-identifies it at scenes 40, 45, 53, 61-63, 69 and 76.

checks.item: historical bridge quote introduced in narration before quote image switch
checks.evidence: Scene 47 says 回到《張飛傳》; scene 48 says 接著還記下他朝追兵喊出的原話; scene 49 switches to the quote shot and recites the original. The fiction-framed to unframed source transition itself occurs at scene 47 as that narration begins, so exact lead time before that earlier frame change is not established by the JSON.

Scenes 37-46 are fiction-framed; scenes 47-51 are unframed and identify 《張飛傳》; scene 52 restores a fiction frame as narration asks how the novel rewrites the challenge. Scenes 52-78 retain fiction frames; scene 79 removes the frame while saying 《先主傳》另記.

checks.item: Cao Cao canopy continuity in prompt scene 56
checks.evidence: YY42 line 36 and narration scene 55 say Cao Cao orders his own canopy removed (曹操急令去其傘蓋 / 撤去自己的傘蓋). The next visual prompt at scene 56 says 'one commander watching the bridge from under a lowered canopy', which may depict him still sheltered by it. Revise this prompt before image generation or check the actual frame and replace it if the canopy remains overhead.
